table_description: Fact table recording every line-item purchase made through the web channel (e-commerce). Structurally similar to CATALOG_SALES but references web-specific dimensions (WEB_PAGE, WEB_SITE) instead of CALL_CENTER and CATALOG_PAGE. At SF100TCL scale contains approximately 72 billion rows.
use_cases: Web channel revenue and profit analysis
Web site and web page performance
Shipping mode preferences for online orders
Cross-channel revenue comparison (web vs store vs catalog)
data_quality_notes: WS_SOLD_DATE_SK can be NULL — filter with IS NOT NULL for date-bounded queries.
WS_BILL_CUSTOMER_SK and WS_SHIP_CUSTOMER_SK can differ for gift orders.
WS_ORDER_NUMBER groups line items — use COUNT(DISTINCT WS_ORDER_NUMBER) for order-level counts.
WS_EXT_SHIP_COST is the shipping charge for this line item.
Join to WEB_SITE using WS_WEB_SITE_SK = WEB_SITE_SK.
Join to WEB_PAGE using WS_WEB_PAGE_SK = WP_WEB_PAGE_SK.
This table is partitioned on WS_SOLD_DATE_SK — always filter by date to control scan size.

table_columns.name: WS_SOLD_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to DATE_DIM. Sale date. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: WS_SOLD_TIME_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to TIME_DIM. Time of sale.

table_columns.name: WS_SHIP_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to DATE_DIM. Ship date. May differ from sale date.

table_columns.name: WS_ITEM_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to ITEM. Part of composite primary key.

table_columns.name: WS_BILL_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER. Billing customer. Use for revenue attribution.

table_columns.name: WS_BILL_CDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_DEMOGRAPHICS.

table_columns.name: WS_BILL_HDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS.

table_columns.name: WS_BILL_ADDR_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_ADDRESS. Billing address.

table_columns.name: WS_SHIP_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER. Ship-to customer. Can differ from billing customer.

table_columns.name: WS_SHIP_CDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_DEMOGRAPHICS.

table_columns.name: WS_SHIP_HDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS.

table_columns.name: WS_SHIP_ADDR_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_ADDRESS. Shipping address.

table_columns.name: WS_WEB_PAGE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to WEB_PAGE.WP_WEB_PAGE_SK. Page the item was purchased from.

table_columns.name: WS_WEB_SITE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to WEB_SITE.WEB_SITE_SK. Web property.

table_columns.name: WS_SHIP_MODE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to SHIP_MODE. Delivery method.

table_columns.name: WS_WAREHOUSE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to WAREHOUSE. Fulfillment warehouse.

table_columns.name: WS_PROMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to PROMOTION. Promotion applied. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: WS_ORDER_NUMBER
table_columns.description: Web order number. Groups line items. Part of composite primary key with WS_ITEM_SK.

table_columns.name: WS_QUANTITY
table_columns.description: Units ordered.

table_columns.name: WS_WHOLESALE_COST
table_columns.description: Wholesale cost per unit.

table_columns.name: WS_LIST_PRICE
table_columns.description: List price per unit.

table_columns.name: WS_SALES_PRICE
table_columns.description: Actual selling price per unit.

table_columns.name: WS_EXT_DISCOUNT_AMT
table_columns.description: Total discount on this line item.

table_columns.name: WS_EXT_SALES_PRICE
table_columns.description: Extended sales price = WS_QUANTITY * WS_SALES_PRICE. Primary revenue field.

table_columns.name: WS_EXT_WHOLESALE_COST
table_columns.description: Extended wholesale cost.

table_columns.name: WS_EXT_LIST_PRICE
table_columns.description: Extended list price.

table_columns.name: WS_EXT_TAX
table_columns.description: Tax amount.

table_columns.name: WS_COUPON_AMT
table_columns.description: Coupon discount.

table_columns.name: WS_EXT_SHIP_COST
table_columns.description: Shipping cost for this line item.

table_columns.name: WS_NET_PAID
table_columns.description: Amount paid after coupons, before tax.

table_columns.name: WS_NET_PAID_INC_TAX
table_columns.description: Net paid including tax.

table_columns.name: WS_NET_PAID_INC_SHIP
table_columns.description: Net paid including shipping.

table_columns.name: WS_NET_PAID_INC_SHIP_TAX
table_columns.description: Total payment including shipping and tax.

table_columns.name: WS_NET_PROFIT
table_columns.description: Net profit. Can be negative.
